title.zh: 肌肉附着点：作用线两端 vs MyoFullBody 肌腱两端
title.en: Muscle attachment sites: ends of our lines of action vs the tendon ends of MyoFullBody

method.zh: 只比带作用线的肌肉。每一端先看它随哪个节段运动（我们：作用线端点绑定的关节；参照：肌腱第一个/最后一个 site 所在的骨）；节段不同记为 not comparable。节段相同时，把点换成节段内的归一化坐标再比：长节段（大腿、小腿、足、上臂、前臂、手）用 [沿近端关节中心→远端关节中心的分数, 离轴距离/节段长度]（不含绕轴的方位角）；骨盆用以两髋中点为原点、按两髋间距归一化的三维坐标；肩带以盂肱关节中心为原点、按肱骨长度归一化；躯干以 L5/S1 为原点、按 L5/S1 到胸锁关节的高度归一化。差值乘以我们的节段长度得到毫米。参照的多个肌束取该端位置的平均。
method.en: Only muscles with a line of action. For each end, first the segment it moves with (ours: the joint the end is bound to; reference: the body of the first / last tendon site); different segments give "not comparable". On the same segment the point is expressed in normalised segment coordinates: for long segments (thigh, shank, foot, upper arm, forearm, hand) [fraction along proximal→distal joint centre, radial distance / segment length] (the azimuth about the axis is not compared); for the pelvis a 3D offset from the mid-point of the hips over the inter-hip distance; for the shoulder girdle from the glenohumeral centre over the humerus length; for the trunk from L5/S1 over the height from L5/S1 to the sternoclavicular joint. The difference times our segment length gives millimetres. Several reference fascicles are averaged at that end.

tolerance.zh: 25 mm。附着区本身有几厘米宽，参照的端点是“等效点”，我们的端点是附着区的质心；这个数是本项目定的。
tolerance.en: 25 mm. Attachment areas are centimetres wide, the reference ends are effective points and ours are centroids of an attachment area; the figure is this project's choice.

references.name: MyoSim (MyoHub/myo_sim): MuJoCo musculoskeletal models MyoLeg, MyoArm, MyoHand, MyoTorso, composed as MyoFullBody
references.version: MyoHub/myo_sim commit 93b0ca8f (2026-09-16); evaluated with the PyPI package myo-sim 0.2.3 (model "myofullbody": 123 joints, 416 muscle actuators) in MuJoCo 3.15.0

notes.zh: 参照是“量具”不是真值：两个模型都是由少数尸体标本和 MRI 做成的通用成年人模型，肌肉是带途经点和缠绕面的折线。MyoLeg 源自 Rajagopal 模型、MyoArm 源自 MoBL 上肢模型、MyoTorso 源自 SimTK 的腰椎模型，所以下肢的两张表并不独立。我们这一侧，变形后网格的中心线会低估绕过关节的肌肉的长度变化（蒙皮把肌肉沿骨拉伸，不绕行）；表里的差别首先说明“这块肌肉的形状随关节变化得不像参照”，不一定是附着点错了。
notes.en: The references are instruments, not ground truth: both are generic adult models built from a few cadaver specimens and MRI, with muscles as polylines through via points and over wrap surfaces. MyoLeg derives from the Rajagopal model, MyoArm from the MoBL upper-extremity model and MyoTorso from the SimTK lumbar spine model, so the two leg tables are not independent. On our side, the centreline of a skinned mesh under-reads the length change of a muscle that wraps round a joint (skinning stretches the muscle along the bone and does not wrap); a disagreement first says that the muscle's shape does not follow the joint as the reference does, not necessarily that an attachment is wrong.
